payload.description:
Running  reports success almost immediately but the seed logic does not run and no data is written. Investigation shows the Amplify CLI imports  for top-level execution; the current file only exports an async default function that is never invoked.

Behavior expectation:

Feature: Sandbox seed entrypoint execution

Scenario: Developer runs Amplify sandbox seed
Given the dashboard Amplify sandbox exists
When the developer runs 
Then the Plexus seed phases execute
And observable seed logging is emitted
And failures from the seed phases cause the command to fail.
payload.title: Fix sandbox seed entrypoint execution
